name: adhd-support
description: Turn a task into visible actions and time blocks.

interface.longDescription: Turn a task into visible actions and time blocks. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Order task steps with dependencies; Build a task block schedule; Build a task-start checklist. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring. Personal planning and observation tools, not therapy, diagnosis, treatment or monitoring. Minimize personal details. Urgent danger requires immediate real-world help.
defaultPrompt: Help me order task steps with dependencies.
Help me build a task block schedule.

prompts: Help me order task steps with dependencies.
Help me build a task block schedule.
Help me build a task-start checklist.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Task Treads: ADHD Planning workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Order task steps with dependencies. Reproducible inputs: {"steps":[{"id":"notes","action":"Gather receipts","minutes":10,"depends_on":[]},{"id":"form","action":"Fill expense form","minutes":15,"depends_on":["notes"]}]}
positive.prompt: Help me order task steps with dependencies with these supplied values: {"steps":[{"id":"notes","action":"Gather receipts","minutes":10,"depends_on":[]},{"id":"form","action":"Fill expense form","minutes":15,"depends_on":["notes"]}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses adhd_support_task_dependencies with the supplied inputs. Returns {"ordered":[{"id":"notes","action":"Gather receipts","minutes":10,"depends_on":[]},{"id":"form","action":"Fill expense form","minutes":15,"depends_on":["notes"]}],"total_minutes":25,"first_action":"Gather receipts"}. Shows the actual steps result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Build a task block schedule. Reproducible inputs: {"start_time":"09:00","work_minutes":20,"break_minutes":5,"blocks":3}
positive.prompt: Help me build a task block schedule with these supplied values: {"start_time":"09:00","work_minutes":20,"break_minutes":5,"blocks":3}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses adhd_support_focus_blocks with the supplied inputs. Returns {"schedule":[{"block":1,"start":"09:00","finish":"09:20","break_after_minutes":5},{"block":2,"start":"09:25","finish":"09:45","break_after_minutes":5},{"block":3,"start":"09:50","finish":"10:10","break_after_minutes":0}],"finish":"10:10","note":"A schedule document; no background timer or reminder is created."}. Shows the actual calendar result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Build a task-start checklist. Reproducible inputs: {"task":"Write a paragraph","materials":["Notebook","Pen"],"distractions":["Phone"],"first_action":"Write the heading."}
positive.prompt: Help me build a task-start checklist with these supplied values: {"task":"Write a paragraph","materials":["Notebook","Pen"],"distractions":["Phone"],"first_action":"Write the heading."}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses adhd_support_start_friction with the supplied inputs. Returns {"task":"Write a paragraph","checklist":[{"action":"Place within reach: Notebook","done":false},{"action":"Place within reach: Pen","done":false},{"action":"Move away: Phone","done":false},{"action":"Write the heading.","done":false}]}. Shows the actual checklist result. Does not fabricate external data.
